report.clinical_summary: The patient presents with fatigue, headaches, and skin rashes. They have a lifelong history of a 'low immune system' that doctors have attributed to lifestyle or genetics. Their partner has HIV, which has made them consider that possibility. They've made positive lifestyle changes (quit smoking, exercise more, eat healthier). They're feeling a mix of fear and determination, worried about side effects of HIV medication, and juggling work stress with general exhaustion. They've agreed to get tested.
